pretreatment: Chemically oxidized with a three-step procedure: treatment in H2O:HCl:H2O2 solution, removal in HF:H2O solution, and re-oxidation in H2O:HCl:H2O2 solution. For Ge(100), native oxide was removed with HF:H2O solution.
evidence: Si(100) wafers were chemically oxidized before deposition with a three-step procedure: first, treatment for 10 minutes in a 5:1:1 H2O:HCl:H2O2 solution at 85 °C; the oxidized species were then removed in a 1:50 HF:H2O solution for 30 s at room temperature; finally a thin layer of chemical SiO2 was created repeating the treatment for 10 minutes in a 5:1:1 H2O:HCl:H2O2 solution at 85 °C. Ge(100) wafers were freed from native oxide by dipping them for 30 s in a 1:50 HF:H2O solution.
